title: A little loud, and a little overly safety aware
text: A little loud, and a little overly safety aware. I hesitated buying this because the design is similar to one I got from another manufacturer that ended up not working well due to the "safety feature" that requires you to unplug it between every use.  This one has the same exact feature (which is overkill--I get you need to let it cool down, but if it's been "off" for several hours, I shouldn't have to still unplug it just to reset the unit EVERY TIME).  So far, this one seems to be working okay, however, it's much louder than my older styles of warm mist.  I feel like this is still trying to be a cool mist (with the fan) but it somehow does warm the water as well.  It would not work in my bedroom overnight as it's too much noise for me. It works okay, but the safety feature is annoying enough that I wish I could send it back and find a different one--sadly, they all seem to have this feature now.
